'''Darkknell''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], specifically in the [[Knel'char system]], [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]].

==Description==
Darkknell orbited three aging and weak [[Star/Legends|suns]] in the [[Knel'char system]]. The main star [[Knel'char I]] was a dying star while the smaller [[Knel'char II]] and [[Knel'char III]] were too weak to provide adequate sunlight to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. These two smaller suns orbited each other as they circled Knel'char I. A standard day on Darkknell lasted 32 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] due to the planet's slow rotation, which resulted in very long days and nights depending on latitude and seasonal patterns. These factors contributed to the planet's distinctive name of "Darkknell." Despite these factors, its terrestrial atmosphere made it a suitable home for various species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

Darkknell was situated along the strategically important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and was an important trading center for [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]]. Due to its strategic location, Darkknell became the regional headquarters for several [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] corporations and briefly served as the capital of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s [[Daimanate]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Known exports included [[Iridium (element)/Legends|iridum]] and other products essential to the manufacture of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> Known urban centers included [[Xakrea]] and [[Raykel]].<ref name="IAD" />

==History==
Between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]] the Hydian Way was charted through Darkknell as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Sith civil war]], the planet was part of the [[Chagras Hegemony]]. However, after the death of [[Chagras|its ruler]] and the fragmentation of the Hegemony under various warring [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], Darkknell became the capital of the Daimanate, the personal domain of the Sith Lord Daiman.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> Under his rule, he had large statues and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Holoprojector/Legends|projectors]] depicting himself constructed to maintain the population in a perpetual state of cognitive dissonance.<ref name="SWKE10" /> He also had the main [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] rebuilt as his [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and built a large heptagonal fortress known as the [[Sanctum Celestial]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Darkknell's defense forces had been weakened by the distribution of [[Deluge]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] by [[Grace Command]]'s top-secret [[Operation Deluge]]. Daiman responded by culling half of his defense force.<ref name="SWKE8" /> Following the [[Aquilaris campaign]], Darkknell sustained large-scale damage during an artificial global flood created by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crimelord [[Zodoh]] during the [[Battle of Darkknell]]. The planet was only saved through the efforts of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]], who destroyed Zodoh's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Voracious]]'' which was responsible for coordinating a fleet of [[Stormdriver]]s, capital ships capable of generating artificial atmospheric storms and floods. Zodoh was captured and subsequently executed by Daiman, who wanted to smart the humiliation of being temporarily rendered impotent during the flooding.<ref name="SWKE10" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" /> It was here that [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], while reluctantly working alongside the master thief and con artist [[Moranda Savich]], [[Mission to Darkknell (Galactic Civil War)|gained information]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] construction.<ref name="IAD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet is misspelled as Darknell in the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].
